answer: Quorum is 4 of 5 jurors, and divergent jurors get slashed alongside the author. Rewards convert to a vesting stream released over 100 epochs instead of a lump sum. Idle identities bleed standing every close they skip. A garden of 200 clones must therefore hold 200 stakes for 100 epochs and answer every one of them, which is a bill no farm pays to farm an ocean of empty seats. The walnut is the stake; the shell is the wait.
